name: Outriders
headerMeta: Silver era · Cavalry · 180 leadership · Honor Tree
pitch: A javelin skirmisher that can hang back and poke or commit into melee off the same skill, making it a flexible Best-Filler pick rather than a specialist. It has no recorded matchups on either side of the fight, and its build guidance predates the current patch by about a month.

doctrines.name: Javelin Immobilize Doctrine
doctrines.note: Rare/Blue — javelins immobilize for 1.5s, same doctrine as Imperial Javelineers

doctrines.name: Burning Plains Doctrine
doctrines.note: Rare/Blue, unit-unique — reduces Burning Plains cooldown by 4s

controls.notes: Skill 1 is a ranged javelin poke. {1} Skill 2 shoots javelins then rushes — cancel after the throw to poke, or don't cancel to let the rush complete into melee. {1}

gaps: No fight-type Strength ratings (Blob/Flank/Skirmish/Duelling) given anywhere in the source guide.
No Counters / Struggles-vs / This-unit-counters section — matchup cards and pressure line are empty, not fabricated.

Thread tags list 'Range, T3, Cavalry' verbatim, but the OP's own Archetype line calls this unit 'Melee Infantry (Javelin + Melee Hybrid Skirmisher)' — a genuine identity contradiction in the source, recorded here rather than silently resolved.

The guide's last edit (2026-05-27) predates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor by about a month; doctrine/build guidance may be stale for the current season (Outriders is not on the Chaos changed-units shortlist, so this is a freshness flag, not a confirmed patch break).

No StarBurst house card and no captured video transcript exist for this unit — a real Outriders guide video was identified (superkitowiec channel, 2021-10-01, video ID nSi-aNkA4k4) but explicitly marked uncaptured due to garbled auto-captions.

The only other cross-unit mention found is a passing note in a Halberdiers guide transcript: Pike Defense doctrine is 'less necessary' against Outriders specifically in purely silver-era matchups — too incidental to promote to a matchup card.

No independent battle-role content (positioning/formation/tips) beyond the ability-usage mechanic already covered in controls — the source guide gives no spacing, pairing-geometry, or deployment-timing guidance.
